description: The transcripts of Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS). No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are Multilingual LibriSpeech's `transcripts.txt` files, inside archives that total about 220 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
